conditional_route_contract: parent-child iff a baseline top-5 source is >=8000 chars and retrieval branches disagree on the first-ranked document; no Gold labels are used
limitations: WixQA Gold identifies relevant articles, not answer spans; document Recall and multi-article packing are valid, but section localization is not measured.
This precheck cannot establish generation or citation quality.
Latency is serial local retrieval on a small corpus, not a load test.
ranking_contract: Raw-only 1.0; BM25 .75 + Dense .25; RRF k=10; first-stage only; MRR@5 is not LLM-reranked
